scripts.check: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint && turbo run typecheck && turbo run test && turbo run build
scripts.dev: VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-http://localhost:${API_PORT:-8787}} APP_ORIGIN=${APP_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:${WEB_PORT:-5173}} AUTH_BASE_URL=${AUTH_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${API_PORT:-8787}} concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "pnpm --filter @trackfi/api dev" "sh -c 'until curl --silent --fail http://localhost:${API_PORT:-8787}/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.2; done; pnpm --filter @trackfi/web dev'"
